title: horror-o-bunches
description: this modpack is not for the weak! do not play if you are scared easly
body:
# horror-o-bunches

**WARNING:** Pure terror ahead. Built by Ian in Tennessee for horror fans who crave fear. Forge 1.19.2 survival with endless scares—solo or multiplayer screams!

## Features
- **Stalkers & Hunters**: Mods like The Man From The Fog, From The Fog, Cave Dweller—lurk in shadows.
- **Jumpscares & Ghosts**: Creepy sounds, hauntings, sanity drain.
- **Horror Mobs**: Evolving undead, cursed witches, iconic slashers (The Boiled One, etc.).
- **Atmosphere**: Fog, dim caves, immersive dread.

Check full mod list in Versions tab—remove weak ones!

## Why Play
Heart-pounding action for brave players. Multiplayer betrayal vibes. Customize terror level.

## Install
1. Prism/Modrinth App download.
2. 4-6GB RAM.
3. Headphones on, lights off.

Chill alternative: My "mods n crap" pack. Feedback welcome! 👻
